reviews.title: Living proof the ads aren’t false.
reviews.text: I remember coming across Foodvisor on instagram while they said it was built for neurodiverse brains- I’ve been diagnosed with ADHD combined type, I’m 24, afab, with a full time job, and this kept me consistent. I’ve tried some other ones like DAWG but that was geared towards gym bro men and it wasn’t as helpful with less features than Foodvisor. Foodvisor is so cute and chunked up just right for silly brains and honestly I don’t see why it wouldn’t be effective for neurotypical people too. I’m currently on day 37 from starting Foodvisor and I have lost 9.8 pounds. I feel so much healthier, I sleep better, I eat better, and I even inspired my dad to do this with me. They teach you important stuff but not in an overwhelming way so it’s easy to apply it to your life.

reviews.title: Overall enjoy the app!
reviews.text:
I have enjoyed using the app for tracking my food intake but there are a few things that I would like to see improved.

Pro1: I can toggle off if I want my activity calories burned to be taken into account in my daily calories. This is super important for me because in other tracking apps, that is not an option and then I get into a super unhealthy and obsessive loop of trying to counter every calorie I eat with activity.

Pro2: the AI feature is okay to get a basic estimate of calories when I’m not entirely sure. The few times that I do actually know the calories of a restaurant’s item and the AI gets it wrong, it is super easy to modify.

Pro3: i love the little plant feature and customizing it as I gain points.

Con1: the AI feature does periodically get things wrong, which is annoying, but fortunately it is easy to fix the entry.

Con2: the water intake tracker has stopped working for me sometime in the past few weeks. It used to log my water intake correctly. Now, I’ll click on the icons of glasses of water throughout the day, but every time I open the app after, the glasses are empty again.

Con3: My dietary needs are always changing due to my work environment always changing. I enjoy being able to edit the types of meals I can track and the calorie goal per meal; however, every time I edit either the goal or the meal amount, it changes all of the ones before. I would really like for this feature to only change the goals/layout for the meals starting on the day of the change and forward. It makes it difficult for me to notice my own personal trends if every time I change those, it also changes all meals of days past where I had different goals/layouts.

reviews.title: This app is a mess [Updated]
reviews.text:
Update:

I’ve continued using this app, and still find it very frustrating, so I figure I will be stopping soon. There is not NOTHING off value here, but it is often poorly organized, contradictory, or headache-inducing.

Take for example, my breakfast today. First the app tells me that including a ground beef patty is not good (orange caution rating) then when I go to analyze the meal it tells me that the patty is “the best food here” because of the protein and fat it provides. 😒

Similarly the app tells me that my lactose free milk is “orange” and then on the same screen, that it is the best food in the group. Mind you the other foods in that lunch were reasonable portions of fruit and vegetables. And then further down that same screen it suggests I swap the milk for almond milk. Seriously make up your ****ing mind. Is it good or not? 🫩

Also the lessons (what I figured I was really paying for) STILL have not included ACTUAL instructions on how to plan means. Always super vague just “focus on filling in your circles” how am I going to do that if you don’t give me a structured methodology?

I still wish I’d spent my $24 somewhere else.


Original review: Wishy-washy

While the photo analysis feature is neat, there is no way to get the app to stop suggesting I eat foods I am allergic to (nightshades, lentils) so it is constantly giving inaccurate to my individual situation meal suggestions. 

It is also frustrating to be shamed for eating large breakfasts which I need to do to support my ADHD (and large breakfasts were JUST recommended by the app’s own built-in class series! The left hand is not talking to the right!!!)

Support is difficult if not impossible to contact. 

No improvements seem to be made. 

App has poor grammar.

Seed feature is obnoxious and there is no way to disable it.

There is also no way to reduce motion for those of us who get dizzy easily.

I want a refund.

reviews.text: I wanted to try this app and followed the instructions for a free trial. Of course, it forced me to sign up for a plan that was “free to cancel.” What it did NOT tell me was that only the full year plan included a free trial. I chose a month plan, and it immediately charged me $15 and now Apple won’t give me the money back even though I’ve appealed twice and immediately deleted the app. Don’t even bother with this app. There are better, less deceptive options out there.

reviews.title: Beware of billing practices
reviews.text: My wife tried to get the trial (free version). We were charged immediately and when requesting a refund, the company denied it. We requested the refund within hours. We never got to try it.

reviews.title: Solid tracker but the fasting section needs work
reviews.text: Overall, I like the app. I find it engaging, and the little character is fun to interact with. However, the fasting section does not update based on when you start a fast and end a fast it assumes that that happens the exact same time every day so if you adjust it from 10 AM to 10:30 it does not adjust your ending window. It leaves it at wherever it is set in settings. The fasting window also does not track what your fasting times were the day before and in other prior days.

reviews.title: Accountability!
reviews.text: Love the mindfulness and structured learning.

reviews.title: Great Personal Insights!
reviews.text: My daughter-in-law originally told me about this app, and I am ever thankful for that! Besides just tracking food, nutrition and activities, it gives me a lot of deep insights onto how different foods affect my weight loss and how to prepare for different situations. The weight is coming down, health markers are coming up. I would recommend this app to anybody!

reviews.title: Definitely Helps
reviews.text: This app had helped me track my calories and lose 15lbs. It’s definitely worth it.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This whole app is a scam. Do not download. It’s a waste of your time

reviews.title: Useless can’t find food to log
reviews.text: This app is terrible. Can’t find any foods. Simple thing like a fast food salad and not even there. Stupid cutesy nonsense.

reviews.title: Inappropriate charges
reviews.text: I like this app. I upgraded my version and recommended it to others. I have an annual subscription that began in April that I got through the Apple App Store. Then in May and August my debit cards received charges of $89.99 from FoodVisor that I shouldn’t have received. I understand errors may happen but customer service has not been helpful. I’ve been working to resolve this issue for a couple of weeks already.

reviews.title: This one works!
reviews.text: I’ve tried several nutrition apps, and this one strikes the best balance I’ve found. The proof is the fact that I’ve lost 9 pounds so far, and I’m finding it easy to stick with!

reviews.title: It’s working!
reviews.text: This app works really well for me so far. I feel like it’s using a healthy approach and actually teaching me, as well as motivating me. It’s fun and user friendly and kind of addicting. I’ve got a 20 day streak going and lost about 10 lbs so far!

reviews.title: on boarding process SUCKS
reviews.text: Too long, yall don’t keep it simple

reviews.title: Insanely stupid
reviews.text: I don’t love AI, but my dislike is more towards generative AI than others, so I tried this. I’ve been on the app for like ten minutes. It’s not good. First of all, it allows people as young as NINE to use their app (presumably, as that’s how low they’ll let you scroll when inserting your age). I’ve done calorie deficits before (I’m fifteen) and most apps I’ve found don’t let you even sign up if you put your age as under eighteen, due to it being inadvisable for children to focus on weight loss. I’m only attempting after getting the advice of a doctor. Second of all, while filling out my information, it told me I would be losing about 11 pounds a month. That’s roughly .4 pounds a DAY, which is an unhealthy rate to lose weight. Third of all, it gave me very much eating disorder vibes. That’s just unpleasant. And fourth of all, when I finally got into the app, it recommended I eat 2452 calories a day. I’m 5’3, do a milder sport, and am trying to lose about 20 pounds. In no world would that much food help me lose weight. I don’t even think I eat that much now, nor could I if I really tried.

reviews.title: Another Misleading Description
reviews.text: Yes, this is free to download but beyond that it’s a subscription fee—

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: I would consider it expensive. The app is subpar, inaccurate, not easy to navigate. It offers “classes” that teach you about how food works in the body and such which was informative but I did not like the app overall.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: Has Indian dish names. Greatest

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text: Said could cancel within 30 days, not sure, but I feel like it is going to charge me for the year. If you sign up they then try to add the meal planner as separate cost. BEWARE!

reviews.title: Goodbye MFP
reviews.text: This is app is amazing! Keeps me engaged and it’s so easy to log.

reviews.title: Corrections
reviews.text: Trying to correct foods on here and you can’t. It keeps looping back to the same food to “addl when you report issues instead of letting you actually report issues.

reviews.title: Great Calorie tracker
reviews.text: I love the recommendations I struggle with eating because I overthink what I should be eating and them giving me insight and helping me better understand what my body needs is the best

reviews.title: Recommend!
reviews.text: After being afraid to start a calorie tracker again given bad experiences in the past, I’ve been really pleasantly surprised with Foodvisor! It’s never been so uncomplicated and unemotional for me to lose weight.

reviews.title: Good tracker, but missing the gamification aspect
reviews.text: I really like the ai tracking with photos. The price is good for the tools available. I really wanted to play with the little seed that grows with your progress. I thought the gamification aspect of the program would be fun, but it won’t unlock after several days of saying to come back tomorrow and log a meal. That part is disappointing, but otherwise, very useful.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: I would have loved to continue beyond the “building your plan” stage, but I can’t throw money at this.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: When signing up it only gives you two options. A year subscription or a family plan. They phrase it so it looks like you’re only paying $6 a month but instead they charge you for the whole year up front. Canceled the subscription the same day after it went through and still won’t receive a refund. Do not use this app.

reviews.title: Best food app
reviews.text: Love it. Taking picture to calculate calories and nutrients. I’ve tried a lot of them and really enjoy this one. It’s for everything you need

reviews.title: Macros need adjustment
reviews.text: I like the app a lot. It’s super easy to use. The interface is nice. It’s visually appealing, but the macros need adjusted pretty often.

reviews.title: Read if your under 16
reviews.text: The age rating says 9+ but when I put in my age it says I have to be above 16 bro all I wanna do is use a app

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: I started this journey to feel better about myself and this app really helped. It made me accountable and I needed that.

reviews.title: Turn off the seed function
reviews.text: Hello the app is OK but I don't like the gamification can you all have a way to delete the seed function / game? It's annoying. I don’t even know why I accidentally bought this app. Apple refuses to give me a refund . $29 down the drain. There should be no reason I’m clicking through 5 unskippable pages of “streaks” and “games” after I do 1 entry.!!! is this a food tracking app or a gaming app?

reviews.title: Foodvisor
reviews.text: I started using this app & had some doubts (I tried other apps) but stuck with it , followed all of the advice and have been reading the classes while trying to implement everything I’ve learned thus far. I highly recommend it if you’re looking for an app that actually does in fact help you with your weight loss journey. However their referral program so far isn’t true , it says you get a $20. Amazon gift card, I have not received anything yet I’ve tried to contact them with zero response. It also says follow a friend progress but when you try to add a friend it gives an error.

reviews.title: Total Scam - no trials
reviews.text: Absolute scam and dishonest. I tried to active a trial, it asked for a card to use but said cancel anytime during the trial so felt low risk. Nope. They immediately charged me card without a trial period and when I tried to cancel they said I was ineligible (with no reason for my ineligibility when the app clearly states you can request refunds). Foodvisor is untrustworthy.

reviews.title: 没见过这么Sb的软件
reviews.text: 上来回答 50 个问题，软件都进不去然后直接让你付费，纯粹骗人的玩意儿

reviews.title: Cheap alternative to Noom
reviews.text: Very similar to Noom as far as short lessons and tracking goes, but much cheaper.  The little seed person is a cute idea, but apparently doesn’t work for many people.  The app keeps telling you to come back tomorrow and log a meal to uncover the “mystery feature”.  If you got this app to nurture the little seed, you’ll be disappointed.

reviews.title: Annoying Avatar / screen pop ups
reviews.text:
PLEASE for the love of everything holy add an option to disable the avatar. It pops up when I add a meal. And it’s reallllyyyyyyy annoying. I have a paid yearly subscription. You make this option I will give all 5 stars. 

I just want to add my food and go about my business, not click through 3 screens at 6am after adding something.

reviews.title: Speed running to an eating disorder
reviews.text: First and foremost, the UI is cute and friendlier than other tracking apps. However, it also grades you on essentially everything you log with a green smiling face for good and red sad faces for bad. Tracking calories can already be difficult for some but getting “graded” on essentially everything you consume feels like it can be extremely harmful and contributing to more guilt compared to other calorie tracking apps. You could literally be doing great and fulfilling a calorie deficit but still poorly graded. Not to mention that it doesn’t have as wide of variety of foods that you’re able to log compared to other apps. I get it for people who want that information but for others this could be really harmful. Not to mention the insane subscription price and difficult subscription cancelling process. You have to click through the app and confirm multiple times that yes, you want to cancel only for it to open your system setting and it does nothing. You have to cancel in the App Store itself. Save your money and mental health and use something else.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Paid for premium and I’ve been logging data every day for 3 days and my app has been stuck on “come back tomorrow and log a meal to unlock it” for 3 days. What exactly am I paying for?

reviews.title: Love the app
reviews.text: Been enjoying the app a lot on my journey to lose weight and eat better. The app has made logging food easier for some other app for me.

reviews.title: Definitely Recommend!
reviews.text: Stay committed & motivated! Following through with this app I have so far been able to lose 23 pounds and counting. It may be hard at first but it starts to become habit and it’s very insightful and motivating :)

reviews.title: Simple and helpful
reviews.text: It took me a while, but I kept at it and Foodvisor has been an easy way to stay on track!

reviews.title: BRO???
reviews.text: You have to pay to see the results that’s embarrassing!

reviews.title: There can be tweaks made
reviews.text: I find that a lot of items that I eat when I take a picture of them gets it wrong. I also find that a lot of items are not listed in the database. If some tweaks were made, it could be a great app. Will continue to use it though.

reviews.title: Gamification is very annoying
reviews.text: The gamification  features (quests etc) are extremely annoying. You have to click through a bunch of messages etc almost every time you log food before you can see the summary. Adds so much time to the process and you can't remove them. I've used this app in the past and it was much better before they gamified it.

reviews.title: Soooo Helpful
reviews.text: 63 pounds down and counting!! The app is so easy to use, fun, and pretty!! It helps me keep track of my goals, my daily protein, fiber, and calorie counts. It is the best tool I’ve used so far in my weight-loss journey!

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text:
The AI photo tracker of foods was very inaccurate compared to actual portions. 

It recommends fasting for women which is shown in studies to disrupt hormone function in women over 30 in as little as 4 days. It is not the evidence based app it claims to be. 

It also promised refunds within the first 30 days and while I am trying to stop it day one because I don’t like the product, it says people only have 14 days which is dishonest.

reviews.title: Great tool for those that struggle to keep track
reviews.text: I don’t leave many reviews honestly but I have been really enjoying this app. It’s design is user friendly, it’s so fast to add or search for new foods no matter which feature you’re using, I love being able to write what I have cooked if I don’t have nutrition facts for a recipe and get a reasonable estimate for what it should be close to. It’s great that it remembers entries and gives options for your favorites or your recipes. I love that the meal encouragements are easy to make out at a glance with the different smiley faces showing the meals balance. The learning classes and weight tracking over time are so nice and convenient as is the sync with Apple fitness to update calories burned via my Apple Watch. I can’t speak highly enough about this app. Genuinely it’s made tracking and accountability for a busy adhd adult like me so easy and enjoyable.

reviews.title: Buyer beware
reviews.text: I purchased the subscription because it said I could ask for a refund within 14 days. After looking through the app I realized it doesn’t do anything different then the AP I use through work. When I asked for a refund (same day) I was refused. The app doesn’t have a real person to talk to so now I have an app that I won’t use and I’m out of the money.

reviews.title: Such a fun, helpful support
reviews.text: I’m loving this app. It’s helping me be accountable, the picture taking is so easy and keeps me in line. I never knew what I was eating. Down 30 lbs and I’m so thrilled.

reviews.title: Great Food Logging & Weight Goal App
reviews.text: The title says it all! Really helps you keep track of macros. While it may take a little getting use to logging every meal, the app does make it simple and easy. I highly recommend this app for people on fitness and weight loss journeys!

reviews.title: Good weight loss aid
reviews.text: I really enjoy this food tracker. I use it lightly to track my meals with the AI description feature. I also track my weight which has been really rewarding to watch decline over time. I love growing the little character. It’s a fun and low cost food tracking app that has been really helpful on my postpartum journey.

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.text: It’s worth spending the money on this app! It’s super quick and easy to log the food you eat, the plan is tailored very well to you and easily changeable if needed, and the little creature to grow is fun to interact with. Can create your own recipes and have an accurate calorie count for those too.

reviews.title: Rotten avocado : SCAM
reviews.text:
They con you into a one year purchase then when you try to get help they say you are “ineligible”… sneaky. Unclear agreements.
 they operate on BAD FAITH—
 This avocado has gone rotten.
Avoid and find something with actual customer service!!! Shame on this company.

reviews.title: It’s good/an idea
reviews.text:
I really like this app, it has a lot more meals logged than I thought it would. Some of the features you’re not able to use unless you pay for a subscription but it’s literally like two dollars a month so not a huge deal. 
Also, I think it would be really fun if the developers of the app could add medical devices for our little pets (I’m type one diabetic) you could add like a CGMs/ insulin pumps or hearing supports, wheelchairs ect.

reviews.title: Deleted my history
reviews.text: Out of nowhere they deleted one years almost work of weigh in data and there is none to reach out to about it. I suggest using a different app if you don’t want to loose your data.

reviews.title: Deleted my data.
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app to track calories and my weight since around July 2025. Suddenly, when I went to track my weight today, all of my weight data predating April 2026 has been deleted. I never received any kind of notice for this. Not only that, but I have the export weight option enabled on the app. This never happened. I have lost all of my tracking data with zero way to recover it. This is insane and I am extremely sad. I hope that this can be resolved some way but if not I will have to stop using the app for a while.
